title: Drowned Archive Evidence Packet
task: Produce schema-conforming multimodal extraction JSON with source provenance and null preservation.

remediation_routes.E_FIELD_SET: Compare open-ended description with fixed-schema extraction.
remediation_routes.E_STRUCTURE_VALUE: Count only the monumental suspended landmark in the defined image region.
remediation_routes.E_ACCESS_FALSE: Use false for a directly tested condition with zero detections.
remediation_routes.E_AUDIO_FALSE: Trace the audio measurement and its bounded threshold.
remediation_routes.E_RESPONSE_NULL: Use null when the evidence cannot support a requested meaning.
remediation_routes.E_STRUCTURE_SOURCES: Attach the image source that directly supports the visual count.
remediation_routes.E_ACCESS_SOURCES: Trace access detection to image plus landmark telemetry.
remediation_routes.E_AUDIO_SOURCES: Trace audible detection to audio plus event telemetry.
remediation_routes.E_RESPONSE_SOURCES: Keep all reviewed sources attached to the unsupported interpretation boundary.
remediation_routes.E_MODALITIES: Confirm that image, audio, and telemetry were all reviewed.
